children: Kala Bio entered an Exclusive Distribution and Reseller Agreement with Virotek to commercialize a genetic testing and screening program for ophthalmology in the United States. The deal grants Kala exclusive rights, which convert to non-exclusive if a specified milestone due Sep 3, 2027 is not met after a 30-day cure period. Kala will handle commercial development while Virotek delivers and administers the program, with net profits split 50/50 after Virotek recovers cost of goods. The agreement includes a right of first refusal for Kala on ophthalmological product dispositions and may expand to other verticals by mutual consent.
